notes.note: Reviewed the runtime-http delta and affected origin, authentication, account preference and transport claims. The sole admission change adds If-Match to ordinary allowed-origin preflight headers; origin checks, credentials, scopes, outside-protocol ownership, persistence and platform transports retain their existing behavior. API CORS prose now names If-Match. The focused runtime HTTP suite passed 85 tests including PATCH /api/me/preferences preflight; this is local middleware evidence, not a live server or release verification.
